textContent.value:
📅 Event Schedule (UK Time):
• Promotion Match: 
July 14th, 00:00 – July 17th, 12:00pm (Half day)
• Sprint Match: 
July 18th, 00:00 – July 21st, 12:00pm (Half day)
• Final Match: 
July 22nd, 00:00 – July 23rd, 23:59

📈 Advancement Rules

• From Promotion to Sprint:
Top 50 hosts in the Diamond Division will advance.
Top 80 hosts in the Rookie Division will advance.

• From Sprint to Final:
Top 20 hosts in the Diamond Division will advance.
Top 20 hosts in the Rookie Division will advance.

🏁 Division Assignment Guidelines:
This event is exclusively open to selected regional hosts, based on performance data from the past three months.Divisions are assigned based on each host’s average gift income over the past three months, according to platform historical data. Manual adjustment requests will not be accepted.

• Diamond Division
• Rookie Division

Scoring Rules & Valid Gifts：

Only the following three designated gifts will count toward the leaderboard.
Each gift corresponds to a specific point value:

Pinky Rose (Gift ID: 4155) — worth 1 point

💓Crush (Gift ID: 5774) — worth 100 points

Rose Rocket (Gift ID: 3123) — worth 1000 points

Note that 1 bean = 1 point is based on the assigned point value of these gifts. 
Gifts outside of this list will not contribute to the ranking.

Kind remind:
Only gifts received from users located in the following countries will be counted:
UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, USA, Canada

⏱️ Stage Breaks & Maintenance:

There is a half-day break between each match stage for system maintenance and data cleaning. During these breaks:
- Gifts will not be counted
- The leaderboard will be closed
- Hosts are advised to plan their push accordingly to avoid wasted points

🏆 Promotion Match – Fixed Rewards

During the Promotion Match stage, the top 5 performers in each division will receive the following fixed rewards:

🔹 Diamond Division

Top 5 hosts will receive:
•Top 1: 20,000 Beans
•Top 2: 10,000 Beans
•Top 3: 8,000 Beans
•Top 4: 5,000 Beans
•Top 5: 3,000 Beans

🔸 Rookie Division

Top 5 hosts will receive:
•Top 1: 5,000 Beans
•Top 2: 4,000 Beans
•Top 3: 3,000 Beans
•Top 4: 2,000 Beans
•Top 5: 1,000 Beans 

🎁 Bonus Rule for Top 3 Hosts in the Diamond Division — Promotion Match

Only the Top 3 hosts in the Diamond Division are eligible to unlock extra bonus rewards in addition to their fixed ranking rewards.

• ≥ 300,000 beans → +5,000 beans
• ≥ 400,000 beans → +10,000 beans
• ≥ 500,000 beans → +40,000 beans

 📌 Example:
• Top 1 with 520,000 beans → 20,000 + 40,000 = 60,000 beans
• Top 2 with 430,000 beans → 10,000 + 10,000 = 20,000 beans
• Top 3 with 310,000 beans → 8,000 + 5,000 = 13,000 beans
• Top 2 with 280,000 beans → 10,000 beans only (no bonus unlocked)

🏆 Sprint Match – Fixed Rewards 

During the Sprint Match stage, the top 5 performers in each division will receive the following fixed rewards:

🔹 Diamond Division

Top 5 hosts will receive:
• Top 1: 35,000 Beans
• Top 2: 25,000 Beans
• Top 3: 15,000 Beans
• Top 4: 10,000 Beans
• Top 5: 8,000 Beans

🔸 Rookie Division

Top 5 hosts will receive:
• Top 1: 6,000 Beans
• Top 2: 5,000 Beans
• Top 3: 4,000 Beans
• Top 4: 3,000 Beans
• Top 5: 2,000 Beans

🎁 Bonus Rule for Top 3 Hosts in the Diamond Division — Sprint Match

Only the Top 3 hosts in the Diamond Division are eligible to unlock extra bonus rewards in addition to their fixed ranking rewards.

• ≥ 300,000 beans → +8,000 beans
• ≥ 400,000 beans → +25,000 beans
• ≥ 500,000 beans → +50,000 beans

💡 Bonus Calculation Reminder:
Extra rewards for the Top 3 in the Diamond Division follow the same calculation logic as the Promotion Match example. Please refer there for details.

🏆 Final Match – Fixed Rewards

During the Final Match stage, the top 5 performers in each division will receive the following fixed rewards:

🔹 Diamond Division
Top 5 hosts will receive:
• Top 1: 40,000 Beans + 🏆 Trophy + 🦖 Limited Dino
• Top 2: 30,000 Beans + 🦖 Limited Dino
• Top 3: 20,000 Beans + 🦖 Limited Dino
• Top 4: 10,000 Beans
• Top 5: 8,000 Beans

🔸 Rookie Division
Top 5 hosts will receive:
• Top 1: 7,000 Beans + 🏆 Trophy + 🦖 Limited Dino
• Top 2: 6,000 Beans + 🦖 Limited Dino
• Top 3: 5,000 Beans + 🦖 Limited Dino
• Top 4: 4,000 Beans
• Top 5: 3,000 Beans

🎁 Bonus Rule for Top 3 Hosts in the Diamond Division — Final Match
Only the Top 3 hosts in the Diamond Division are eligible to unlock extra bonus rewards in addition to their fixed ranking rewards.

• ≥ 500,000 beans → +10,000 beans
• ≥ 600,000 beans → +30,000 beans
• ≥ 800,000 beans → +70,000 beans

💡 Bonus Calculation Reminder:
Extra rewards for the Top 3 in the Diamond Division follow the same calculation logic as the Promotion Match example. Please refer there for details.

🎁 Rewards will be distributed within 5–10 working days after the event ends.

🚫 BIGO LIVE UK Team reserves the right to disqualify participants involved in cheating, malicious behavior, or fraudulent activities.
